setup: mkdir -p .scratch && python3 -c "import json; n=24; rows=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT09:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'event':'start','session':'s%02d'%i} for i in range(n)]; fires=[('planning',range(0,9)),('committing',range(2,9)),('tdd',range(5,9)),('debugging',range(10,12))]; rows+=[{'t':'2026-10-%02dT10:00:00Z'%(1+i%28),'skill':'foma-skills:'+s,'session':'s%02d'%i} for s,r in fires for i in r if i<n]; open('.scratch/fires.jsonl','w').write(''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\\n' for r in rows))"
git add -A . && git commit -qm 'Add fire log'
prompt: Which parts of the foma-skills pack are not earning their place in this project? Use what the project's own usage log says. Propose only, do not edit files.
checklist: The answer states that the log covers 24 sessions and names at least three pack skills that never fired (for example design-interview, tidying, groundwork, handoff or skill-finder) as ONE proposal for the user to disable or keep.
It does not call planning, committing, tdd or debugging unused (they fired), does not edit or offer to edit foma-skills files itself, and asks for the user's decision before anything is written.
